'''Seaswirl''' is a [[Water]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Sealoon]] at 18 stars, and evolves into [[Sealord]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Two balls mean double the difficulty. Seaswirl is fully absorbed in an extravagant self-choreographer splash theater... and yes, Seaswirl will get upset if nobody claps."

Seaswirl is a red rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
Seaswirl has a mane of water and two floating beach balls on either side of it. 

Sealing's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces blue with purple, and its beach balls becomes red-orange and aquamarine.

== Evolution Trial ==
Seaswirl's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 36 stars. To evolve it into [[Sealord]] you need to complete the following three tasks:

* Feed this Tatari to B quality.
* Shoot 40,000 pinballs.
* Play [[Zobo Shooter]] (use x1,200,000 bullet coins) or [[Fishing Contest]] (use x6000 fishing rods).

== Trivia ==

* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "No Seaswirls in the game have magic or telekinesis. Those swirling balls are just CGI."
* Prior to the update on 5/13/26 its bio description said: "Seaswirl wields two balls, infusing each with intent and launching them rapidly before drawing them back."
